description: TEAM + SKILL pack for the electrical trade: refines the career as well as the craft. Skill-development entries (improve/combine) level up the electrician — mentoring apprentices, honest estimating and quoting, code-compliant habits, panel schedules, torque discipline, two-pass workflow, conduit bending. Team-play entries train crews to coordinate — two-person lockout/tagout, signaled wire pulls, wrong-parts pivot protocol, teach-back huddles, shadow rotations, and a drilled stop-work play for smoke mid-job. Outputs feed the learning engine; the pack ultimately builds toward personal refinement tools. All entries follow MECHANISM -> IMPROVISE -> STEPS -> STOP. Every entry leads with de-energize-first; anything past homeowner scope stops at 'call a licensed electrician.' Lawful DIY only.
notes_for_main_builder: Starter set of 38 entries plus 14 team+skill entries (sw-electrical-039 to sw-electrical-052): 7 career-skill (improve/combine) + 7 team-play. Ids normalized by coordinator to the framework law (curriculum/schema.py); full file validates clean. Open question: should 'combine' entries like sw-electrical-031 require a cross-pack prerequisite syntax later, or stay pack-local as now?
safety_posture: electricity kills. Every entry de-energizes first (breaker off, verified dead). No mains-panel or live work beyond safe homeowner scope; every entry carries an explicit electrician-call stop condition. Improvised tools never defeat safety: no breaker bypasses, no ungrounded cheats, no taped fuses.

track_emphasis.build: secondary — lamps, outage kits, cord projects with gauge math
track_emphasis.combine: tertiary — combination devices that merge functions in one yoke
track_emphasis.create: tertiary — new devices from parts (lamp builds, photocell adds)
track_emphasis.improve: secondary — load audits, LED retrofits, dimmers, USB outlets, sensors; plus career-skill: mentoring, estimating, quoting, habits, torque, conduit, two-pass workflow
track_emphasis.improvise: primary — Sidewinder doctrine core: lamp tests, knife stripping, coat-hanger fishing, radio breaker-mapping; plus crew plays: lockout/tagout, wire-pull signals, wrong-parts pivot, stop-work ritual
track_emphasis.restore: primary — diagnosis and replacement of worn residential devices
